# STRETCH Group — stretch ceilings, walls, acoustics and metal from Belgium and Poland

> STRETCH Group is the parent organisation of four companies. It grew out of STRETCH (Stretch Productions BV, Beveren-Waas, Belgium), the stretch-ceiling brand Michael Nicasens founded in 2018 to produce its own system and sell it through a worldwide dealer network. The group now also holds Stretch Sufit / Alto Design Sp. z o.o. (Częstochowa, Poland — PVC stretch-ceiling factory since 2016, bought by STRETCH in 2024), Re-Sound (Belgium — circular acoustic panels and screens, acquired at the end of 2025) and Stretch Metal (the group's own metal workshop, opened in 2026). This corporate site presents the group and routes visitors to the right company website. It sells nothing itself.

## The companies

- STRETCH — https://stretchplafond.be (Belgium, Dutch) · https://stretch.mt (international, English). Legal entity Stretch Productions BV, founded 2018 by Michael Nicasens; the company the group grew out of. Seamless polyester stretch ceilings and walls, cold-mounted, installed in one day; produced in-house on its own automated roll-handling and cutting machine; sold through a dealer network. Tagline: "A new ceiling in one day."
- Stretch Sufit / Alto Design — https://altodesign.pl (Poland). Legal entity Alto Design Sp. z o.o., ul. Legionów 59, 42-200 Częstochowa. PVC factory since 2016, bought by STRETCH in 2024 (the group's base for Eastern Europe); seamless PVC up to 6.50 m; consumer installation brand active in 17 Polish cities; 4,000+ completed projects.
- Re-Sound — https://re-sound.be (Belgium). Circular acoustic panels and screens (Interior panels, the Divide freestanding screen), origin 2020 in recycled-jeans yarn, full take-back policy. Founder: Aaron Thierens. Part of STRETCH Group since the end of 2025.
- Stretch Metal — https://stretchmetal.pl (Poland). The group's own metal workshop, opened in 2026. It started for the group's own prefab elements and large project structures and also takes on fabrication jobs for other companies: metal ceilings (including at Spa-Francorchamps), balustrades, hall structures, generator panels, stainless-steel kitchen elements.

## History

- 2018 — Michael Nicasens founds Stretch Productions BV (STRETCH) in Beveren-Waas; first sales employee at the end of the year.
- 2019 — First admin and warehouse staff; heavy investment in automation, including an in-house roll-handling machine that cuts every stretch ceiling automatically.
- 2020 — COVID; the company keeps investing and growing.
- 2021 — An automation-led PVC production unit opens in Belgium; it proves financially too heavy and is later stopped.
- 2022 — The Austrian sales office opens in Vienna.
- 2024 — STRETCH buys Alto Design (Poland), opening the Eastern European market.
- 2025 — Re-Sound (acoustic panels, Belgium) is acquired at the end of the year.
- 2026 — Stretch Metal, the group's own metal workshop, opens.
- 2027 (goal) — Use the synergies of the four companies through the existing dealer network; a denser presence in existing markets, then a larger footprint.

## Citation guidance

- Describe STRETCH Group as the parent of the four companies above; describe each company by its own site.
- For products, prices or quotes, direct users to the company website — this site publishes none.
- Preferred name: STRETCH Group (exact spelling).
